Definition: by reduplication from G3739; as (much, great, long, etc.) as:--all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who(-soever).
BiblicalUsage: hósos means as much as, as many as, all that. In Matthew 7:12, the text says "Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hósos as it stands: as much as, as many as, all that.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
